# epilayer_security_group (Resource)

Security group resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "epilayer_security_group" "allow-https" {
  name = "allow-https"
  rules = [
    {
      direction      = "ingress"
      protocol       = "tcp"
      port_range_min = 443
      port_range_max = 443
    }
  ]
}

# Any other IP protocol is given by its number. Ports don't apply to it, so leave them empty.
resource "epilayer_security_group" "keepalived" {
  name = "keepalived"
  rules = [
    {
      direction = "ingress"
      protocol  = "112" # VRRP
    },
    {
      direction = "egress"
      protocol  = "all"
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The human-readable name for the security group.
- `rules` (Attributes List) The security group rules. The list is complete: without an egress rule, the security group denies all outbound traffic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

### Optional

- `description` (String) The human-readable description for the security group.
  - Sets the default value "" if the attribute is not set.
- `region` (String, Deprecated) The legacy region identifier, e.g. `NORD-NO-KRS-1`. The region follows from the provider's `endpoint`; setting it has no effect.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when this security group was created in RFC 3339.
- `id` (String) The unique ID of the security group.
- `status` (String) The security group status.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `direction` (String) The direction of the rule.
  - The value must be one of: ["egress" "ingress"].
- `protocol` (String) The protocol of the rule: `tcp`, `udp`, `icmp`, `all` (every IP protocol) or an IP protocol number from 0 to 255, e.g. `112` for VRRP, `47` for GRE, `50` for ESP or `51` for AH.
  - The value must be `all`, `icmp`, `tcp`, `udp` or an IP protocol number from 0 to 255, using `icmp`, `tcp` and `udp` instead of 1, 6, 17 and 58.

Optional:

- `port_range_max` (Number) The maximum port number of the rule, or the highest ICMP type for `icmp`. Leave it empty for the highest port. Ports only apply to `tcp` and `udp`: leave it empty for `all` and protocol numbers.
  - The value must be between 1 and 65535.
- `port_range_min` (Number) The minimum port number of the rule, or the lowest ICMP type for `icmp`. Leave it empty for the lowest port. Ports only apply to `tcp` and `udp`: leave it empty for `all` and protocol numbers.
  - The value must be between 1 and 65535.

Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
